description: This file defines API route handlers for authentication-related operations using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for user registration, login, token refresh, and logout, integrating session management with refresh tokens and access tokens.

methods.name: TokenResponse register_user(payload: RegisterRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
methods.description: Handles user registration, creating user tokens upon success and setting refresh cookie.

methods.name: TokenResponse login_user(payload: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
methods.description: Handles user login, validating credentials, providing tokens, and setting refresh cookie.

methods.name: TokenResponse refresh_token(request: Request, response: Response)
methods.description: Refreshes the access token using the refresh token from cookie, rotating refresh tokens for security.

methods.name: logout_user(response: Response)
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing the refresh token cookie.

ctags.signature: (payload: LoginRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))

ctags.signature: (payload: RegisterRequest, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep))
